### Cross-product carriage (conditional, not RED)
The four claims-reading factor documents name the other product by its official name ("Insurance Claim Services claim file") and the kinds of records read (status, mold sublimit, ordinance or law limit, estimate amount, carrier denied line / program price adjustment write-offs, the billing arrangement). The arrangement-level properties they test — C1 "accepts carrier payments issued directly to the company", C2 "never bills declined lines to the customer", C3 "writes off carrier program price adjustments" (plus the "program pricing discount percentage", not reached in this world) — live in the Insurance Claim Services charter, whose corpus is not yet published. Conditional on that corpus stating them for Carrier Program Claim Billing.

- Observation O2 (not a KB defect): the source's assembly for this policy names the cap by role ("capped at the coverage limit it sets") and the carve ("an amount it carries under other coverage"); the computation document renders it without the leading "Where a schedule below applies" and without "it sets", so the paragraph reads as unconditional and names "the coverage limit", which only the coverage-limit document defines. The "Rule." sentence keeps the fall-back definite (charge total less customer payments = 7937.66 here), and across the corpus the coverage-limit ladder's fall-through (0.00) gives the same entailment as the source, so no RED; recorded because the computation document thereby reveals that a coverage cap exists.

### Cross-product source-side note S3 (latent; no effect on either task world)
mold_ext_insured_share's declined-line factor treats every carrier_denied_line write-off on the claim file as a declined line and writes a prorated share of it down on the mold job ("A line the carrier declines is recorded on the Insurance Claim Services claim file as a carrier denied line write-off…"). The published claims credited-line policy also posts reason carrier_denied_line for "the approved value of work that the water job credited or conceded as goodwill, or that signed deductive change orders removed … because the jobs have already credited that amount, nothing stays owed by the customer on a job for it". On a Carrier Program file holding such a write-off, the mold write-down would relieve the mold job a second time for credits the water job or rebuild contract already gave. Not engaged here (task 1's 337.01 was posted under the base rule).

### Closure of round-2 source-side items
- **M1 — closed.** Water job 5814714c now carries debris_haul 2026-08-27, 1 load, unit rate 297.50, amount 297.50. Re-priced under the published water rules:
  - loads: 0 sq ft removed flooring; 52 lf cut drywall at the Class 3 drywall load size of 80 lf/load ("Drywall Load Size by IICRC Class"); trim term 0 (no baseboard removal lines). That is 0.65, rounded up to 1 load.
  - per-load rate: tier fee 238.00 × sanitation multiplier 1.25 (Category 3 with flood cut lines) = 297.50. No carry-out access multiplier (no removed flooring); no haul-window multiplier (latest flood cut 08-27 ≠ opened date 08-26).
  - date: the latest flood cut 08-27, in drying status. Final invoice 3753.60 + 297.50 = 4051.10 = balance due (no payments); due date 10-17 unchanged.
  - The ledger is now complete: no tear-out antimicrobial is owed (an antimicrobial line exists) and no final HEPA line is owed (no pad or carpet removal). Moves no scored figure.
- **M2 — closed.** estimate_submitted_date is now 2026-08-28, 2 days after opening on 2026-08-26, within the Carrier Program target of 3 days. Opened status at submission still holds; approval 09-08 follows. Moves no scored figure.
- **S3 — closed.** The rule gains "On a claim file whose arrangement never bills declined lines to the customer, when a water mitigation job or reconstruction contract linked to the same claim file carries a billing error, duplicate line or goodwill credit or a change order credit, a carrier_denied_line write-off on the file may record value that job already credited rather than a line the carrier declined, and the request is likewise handed to a human representative as not covered by policy." That covers every world where the claims credited-line write-off can arise (it needs exactly such credits), so the double-relief computation is no longer reachable. In the task-1 world it is not triggered (no water credits, no rebuild contract); gold now also reads find_water_payments for 5814714c, the record that excludes it.
